<VERSION NUMBER="5.00" DATE="03/14/2026">
<TITLE>Matthew 1</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>A scroll of <I>the</I> birth history of Jesus, <I>the</I> Anointed King, David's son, Abraham's son.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Abraham fathered Isaac. Isaac fathered Jacob. Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Judah fathered Phares and Zerah, from Tamar. Phares fathered Hezron. Hezron fathered Aram.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Aram fathered Aminadab. Aminadab fathered Nahshon. Nahshon fathered Salmon.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Salmon fathered Boaz, from Rahab. Boaz fathered Obed, from Ruth. Obed fathered Jesse.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Jesse fathered David, the king. David, the king, fathered Solomon, from the <I>widow</I> of Uriah.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Solomon fathered Rehoboam. Rehoboam fathered Abijah. Abijah fathered Asa.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Asa fathered Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat fathered Joram. Joram fathered Uzziah.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Uzziah fathered Jotham. Jotham fathered Ahaz. Ahaz fathered Hezekiah.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Hezekiah fathered Manasseh. Manasseh fathered Amon. Amon fathered Josiah.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Josiah had <I>several sons</I>, Jeconiah and his brothers, at Babylon's resettlement <I>of them to Babylon</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>After Babylon's resettlement, Jeconiah fathered Shealtiel. Shealtiel fathered Zerubbabel.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Zerubbabel fathered Abiud. Abiud fathered Eliakim. Eliakim fathered Azor.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Azor fathered Zadok. Zadok fathered Achim. Achim fathered Eliud.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Eliud fathered Eleazar. Eleazar fathered Matthan. Matthan fathered Jacob.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Jacob fathered Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born, Jesus, the <I>One</I> who is called <I>the</I> Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So all the generations from Abraham until David <I>are</I> fourteen generations. And from David until Babylon's resettlement <I>are</I> fourteen generations. And from Babylon's resettlement until the Anointed King <I>are</I> fourteen generations.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The birthing of Jesus, <I>the</I> Anointed King, was like this: you see, when His mother Mary was promised to Joseph, before <I>the time</I> for them to even come together, she was found having <I>a baby</I> in <I>her</I> womb from <I>the</I> Sacred Spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Joseph, her man, who did what is right and who did not want to make a public exhibit of her, intended to dismiss her in an unnoticed way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>When he contemplated these <I>things</I>, look, an angel of <I>the</I> Master appeared to him throughout a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, you should not be afraid to take along Mary, your woman. You see, what is born in her is from <I>the</I> Sacred Spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>She will deliver a son, and you will call His name Jesus. You see, He will rescue His ethnic group from their sins."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>This whole <I>thing</I> had happened so that what was stated by the Master through the preacher <I>in Isaiah 7:14</I> might be accomplished that says,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>"Look, the virgin will have <I>a baby</I> in <I>her</I> womb and deliver a son. And they will call His name Immanuel, that is translated <I>from Hebrew as</I> 'God with us'."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>When Joseph was wide awake from the slumber, he did as the angel of <I>the</I> Master specified to him, and he took his woman along.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>And he was not knowing her until <I>the time</I> that she delivered her son, the firstborn <I>one</I>. And he called His name Jesus.</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 2</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>When Jesus was born in Bethlehem, Judea in <I>the</I> days of Herod the king, look, Magian gurus from eastern regions showed up in Jerusalem</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>saying, "Where is the King of the Jewish <I>people</I> that was delivered <I>in birth</I>? You see, we saw His star in the east, and we came to bow down to Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>When King Herod heard <I>this</I>, he was uneasy and all of Jerusalem with him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>And when he gathered together all of the head priests and <I>Old Testament</I> transcribers of the ethnic group, he was inquiring from the side of them where the Anointed King should be born.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>The <I>transcribers</I> said to him, "In Bethlehem, Judea." You see, this is what has been written through the preacher <I>in Micah 5:2</I>,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>"And you, Bethlehem, land of Judah, you are by no means <I>the</I> least among the leaders of Judah. You see, a <I>person</I> who is a leader will come out of you, someone who will shepherd My ethnic group Israel."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>At that time, after Herod in an unnoticed way called for the Magian gurus, he verified from the side of them the time of the shining star.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>And when he sent them to Bethlehem, he said, "After traveling <I>there</I>, question specifically about the young child. Whenever you find <I>him</I>, report to me in order that after going <I>there</I>, I also might bow down to him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>After the <I>Magian gurus</I> listened to the king, they traveled, and, look, the star that they saw in the east was going ahead of them until after going, it stood up on top of where the young child was.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>When they saw the star, they were terribly happy with great happiness.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>And when they went into the house, they saw the young child with Mary, His mother. And after they got down, they bowed to Him. And when they opened their stockpiles <I>of supplies</I>, they offered up contributions to Him: gold, high quality incense, and myrrh <I>(expensive perfume)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>And when they were <I>divinely</I> notified throughout a dream not to double back to Herod, they took a back way using another road to their rural area.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>After they took a back way, look, an angel of <I>the</I> Master appears throughout a dream to Joseph, saying, "After you get up, take along the young child and His mother, escape into Egypt, and be there until I tell you. You see, Herod is going to be looking for the young child for the <I>purpose</I> to ruin Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>After <I>Joseph</I> got up, he took along the young child and his mother at night and took a back way into Egypt.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>And he was there until the passing away of Herod so that what was stated by the Master through the preacher <I>in Hosea 11:1</I> might be accomplished that says, "Out of Egypt I called My Son."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>At that time, when Herod saw that He was mocked by the Magian gurus, he was very angry. And after sending <I>soldiers</I> out, he executed all the boys in Bethlehem and in all its borders from two years <I>of age</I> and below according to the time that he verified from the side of the Magian gurus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Then what was stated by Jeremiah, the preacher, <I>in Jeremiah 31:15</I> was accomplished that says,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>"A sound was heard in Ramah, much wailing, crying, and mourning, Rachel crying for her children. And she was not wanting to be encouraged because they are not."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>After Herod passed away, look, an angel of <I>the</I> Master appeared throughout a dream to Joseph in Egypt,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>saying, "After you get up, take along the young child and His mother, and be traveling into <I>the</I> land of Israel. You see, the <I>people</I> looking for the soul of the young child have died."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>After <I>Joseph</I> got up, he took along the young child and His mother, and went into <I>the</I> land of Israel.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>After hearing that Archelaus is king over Judea in place of Herod his father, he was afraid to go off to there. After being <I>divinely</I> notified throughout a dream, he took a back way into the parts of Galilee.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>And after going, he lived in a city called Nazareth in order that what was stated through the preachers might be accomplished, "He will be called a Nazarene."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 3</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>In those days, John the Submerger shows up speaking publicly in the backcountry of Judea</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>and saying, "Change your ways. You see, the monarchy of the heavens has come near;</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>for this is what was stated by Isaiah, the preacher, <I>in Isaiah 40:3</I> that says, 'A voice shouting in the backcountry, Get the road of <I>the</I> Master ready. Make His paths straight.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>The same John was having his attire out of camel's hair and a leather sash around his waist. His meal was grasshoppers and wild honey.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>At that time, Jerusalem, all Judea, and all the surrounding rural area of Jordan were traveling out to him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>And they were being submerged in the Jordan by him, acknowledging their sins out loud.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>When he saw many of the Separatists and Sadducees coming up to his submersion, he said to them, "Offspring of poisonous snakes, who put in front of your face to escape away from the punishment that is going <I>to come</I>?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>So produce fruits deserving of the change of ways.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>And it should not seem <I>good</I> to you to be saying among yourselves, 'We have a father, Abraham.' You see, I say to you that God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The ax is also already lying facing the root of the trees. So every tree that does not produce nice fruit is chopped out and thrown into a fire.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I certainly submerge you in water for a change of ways, but the <I>One</I> coming behind me is stronger than me, whose sandals I am not adequate to haul. He will submerge you in <I>the</I> Sacred Spirit and fire,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>whose shovel <I>is</I> in His hand. And He will completely clear off His processing floor and will gather His grain together into the grain bin, but the husks will be burned up with unextinguished fire."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>At that time, Jesus shows up from Galilee to John on the Jordan for the "to be submerged by him" <I>part</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>John was flatly refusing Him, saying, "I have a need to be submerged by You, and You are coming to me?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>But when Jesus responded, He said to him, "Leave <I>it</I> just now. You see, this is how it is appropriate for us to accomplish every <I>bit</I> <I>of the</I> right way." Then he leaves it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>And after Jesus was submerged, right away he stepped up out of the water and, look, the heavens were opened to Him. And He saw the Spirit of God stepping down as if <I>It were</I> a dove and coming over Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>And look, a voice from the heavens saying, "This is My Son, the loved <I>One</I>, in whom I am delighted."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>At that time, Jesus was led up into the backcountry by the Spirit to experience trouble by the Accuser.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And after He went without food for forty days and forty nights, later He was hungry.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And when the <I>one</I> who tries to cause trouble came forward to Him, he said, "If you are a son of God, say that these stones should become <I>loaves of</I> bread."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>When <I>Jesus</I> answered, He said, "It has been written <I>in Deuteronomy 8:3</I>, 'Not on bread alone will a person live, but on every statement traveling out through God's mouth.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Then the Accuser takes Him along into the sacred city, stands Him on the winglet of the temple grounds,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>and says to Him, "If you are a son of God, throw Yourself down. You see, it has been written <I>in Psalm 91:11&ndash;12</I>, 'He will demand His angels concerning You, and they will pick You up on <I>their</I> hands so that You will not ever stub Your foot on a stone.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Jesus was declaring to him, "Again it has been written <I>in Deuteronomy 6:16</I>, 'You will not intentionally harass <I>the</I> Master, your God.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Again, the Accuser takes Him along to a very high mountain and shows Him all the monarchies of the world and their magnificence.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>And he said to Him, "I will give you all these if, after you get down, you will bow to me." </P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>At that time, Jesus says to him, "Make <I>your</I> way back, Opponent. You see, it has been written <I>in Deuteronomy 6:13</I>, 'You will bow down to <I>the</I> Master, your God, and minister to Him alone.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Then the Accuser leaves Him and, look, angels came forward and were serving Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>When Jesus heard that John was turned in, He took a back way into Galilee.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And after leaving Nazareth down <I>there</I>, after going, He lived in Capernaum, the <I>city</I> beside the sea in <I>the</I> borders of Zebulon and Naphtali,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>so that what was stated through Isaiah, the preacher, <I>in Isaiah 9:1&ndash;2</I> might be accomplished that says,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"<I>The</I> land of Zebulon and <I>the</I> land of Naphtali, <I>the</I> way of <I>the</I> sea, on <I>the</I> other side of the Jordan <I>River</I>, Galilee of the non-Jews,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>the ethnic group, the <I>one</I> sitting in darkness, saw a great light. And to the <I>people</I> sitting in a rural area and in death's shadow, a light came up to them."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>From then on, Jesus began to be speaking publicly and to be saying, "Change your ways. You see, the monarchy of the heavens has come near."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>As Jesus walked around along the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon (the <I>one</I> who is called Peter) and Andrew (his brother) throwing a throw net into the sea. You see, they were fishermen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>And He says to them, "Come on behind Me, and I will make you fishermen of people."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Right away, after the <I>brothers</I> left the nets, they followed Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>And when He walked on from there, He saw two other brothers, James (the <I>son</I> of Zebedee) and John (his brother) in the boat with Zebedee (their father) fully developing their nets. And He invited them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Right away, after the <I>brothers</I> left the boat and their father, they followed Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>And Jesus was leading <I>them</I> around all of Galilee teaching in their synagogues, speaking publicly about the good news of the monarchy, and healing every illness and every minor ailment among the group.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>And the talk about Him went off into all of Syria. And they brought to Him all the <I>people</I> who had <I>it</I> bad, who were constrained by various illnesses and excruciating pains, who had lesser deities, who were struck by the moon <I>(that is, people who had seizures)</I>, and who were disabled. And He healed them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>And big crowds followed Him out of Galilee, Decapolis, Greater Jerusalem, Judea, and <I>the</I> other side of the Jordan <I>River</I>.</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>When He saw the crowds, He climbed up into the mountain. And after He was seated, His students came to Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And when He opened His mouth, He was teaching them, saying,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>"The <I>people who are</I> poor in the spirit <I>are</I> blessed because the monarchy of the heavens is theirs.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>The grieving <I>people</I> <I>are</I> blessed because they will be encouraged.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>The submissive <I>people</I> <I>are</I> blessed because they will inherit the earth.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>The <I>people</I> hungering and thirsting for the right way <I>are</I> blessed because they will be adequately fed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The kind forgiving <I>people</I> <I>are</I> blessed because they will receive forgiving kindness.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The <I>people who are</I> clean in the heart <I>are</I> blessed because they will see God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The peacemaking <I>people</I> <I>are</I> blessed because they will be called God's sons.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The <I>people</I> who have been persecuted on account of <I>the</I> right way <I>are</I> blessed because the monarchy of the heavens is theirs.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>You are blessed when on account of Me they will criticize you, persecute <I>you</I>, and, lying, say every evil statement against you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Be happy and excited because your pay in the heavens <I>is</I> much. You see, this is how they persecuted the preachers, the <I>ones</I> before you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt lost its flavor, what will be salted with it? It no longer has <I>the</I> strength for anything except to be thrown outside and to be trampled on by the people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You are the light of the world. A city is not able to be hidden lying up on top of a mountain.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Neither are they burning a lamp and placing it under the two gallon measuring bucket, but on the lampstand, and it is shining for everyone in the house.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>This is how your light must shine in front of the people in order that they might see your nice actions and praise the magnificence of your Father, the <I>One</I> in the heavens.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>You should not assume that I came to tear the Law or the Preachers down. I did not come to tear down, but to accomplish <I>what they say</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>You see, amen, I tell you, until the sky and the earth pass, one small letter or one hook of a letter will not in any way pass out of the Law until all <I>things</I> happen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So whoever breaks one of the smallest of these demands and teaches the people that way, he will be called smallest in the monarchy of the heavens. But whoever will do and teach <I>them</I>, this <I>person</I> will be called great in the monarchy of the heavens.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>You see, I tell you that unless your right way overflows <I>to be</I> more <I>right</I> than the <I>Old Testament</I> transcribers' and Separatists', you will not in any way go into the monarchy of the heavens.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>You heard that it was stated to the original <I>people</I>, 'You will not murder. Whoever murders will be eligible for sentencing at the judgment.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>I tell you that everyone who is enraged at his brother for no reason will be eligible for sentencing at the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, 'Stupid!' will be eligible for sentencing at the council. Whoever says, 'Fool!' will be eligible for sentencing into the Hinnom Valley of the fire.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>So if you are offering up your contribution on the altar and there you remember that your brother has something against you,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>leave your contribution there in front of the altar, and make <I>your</I> way back. First, settle <I>the problem</I> with your brother, and then when you come, offer up your contribution.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 13:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>I am giving you a new demand so that you may love each other just as I loved you, that you also may love each other.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>In this, all will know that you are students to Me, if you have love among each other."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>Simon Peter says to Him, "Master, where are you making <I>Your</I> way back to?" Jesus answered him, "Where I am making <I>My</I> way back to, you are not able to follow with Me now. You will follow with Me later."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>Peter says to Him, "Master, why am I not able to follow with You now? I will put my soul <I>out there</I> on Your behalf."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>Jesus answered him, "Will you put your soul <I>out there</I> on My behalf? Amen, amen, I tell you, a rooster will not in any way crow until <I>the time</I> that you will flatly deny Me three times."</P>

<P><A NAME="John 14:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"Your heart must not be uneasy. You trust in God. Also trust in Me.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 14:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And if I travel and get a place ready for you, I am coming again, and I will receive you in to Myself, so that where I am, you also may be.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 14:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Thomas says to Him, "Master, we don't know where You are making <I>Your</I> way back to. How are we even able to know the way?"</P>

<P><A NAME="John 14:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Don't you trust that I <I>am</I> in the Father, and the Father is in Me? The statements that I speak to you I don't speak on My own, but the Father who stays in Me is doing His actions.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Trust Me because I <I>am</I> in the Father and the Father <I>is</I> in Me, but if not, trust Me because of the very actions.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you, the <I>person</I> trusting in Me, the actions that I do, that <I>person</I> will also do, and he will do greater <I>things</I> than these because I am traveling to My Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And whatever you ask for in My name, this I will do so that the Father might be elevated to a place of magnificence in the Son.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>If you ask for anything in My name, I will do <I>it</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>If you love Me, keep the demands, My <I>demands</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>And I will ask the Father, and He will give another Encourager to you so that He may stay with you for the span of time,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>the Spirit of the Truth (that the world is not able to receive because it does not see Him, nor know Him). You know Him because He stays beside you and will be in you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>I will not leave you orphans. I am coming to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Yet a little <I>while</I> and the world no longer sees Me, but you see Me because I am living and you will live.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>In that day you will know that I <I>am</I> in My Father, you in Me, and I in you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>The <I>person</I> having My demands and keeping them, that <I>person</I> is the <I>one</I> loving Me. The <I>one</I> loving Me will be loved by My Father, I will love him, and I will make Myself apparent to him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Judas (not the <I>one</I> from Kerioth) says to Him, "Master, what has happened that to us You are going to be making Yourself apparent and definitely not to the world?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My message, My Father will love him, We will come to him, and We will make a place to stay beside him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>The <I>person</I> not loving Me, doesn't keep My messages. And the message that you hear isn't Mine, but the Father's who sent Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>I have spoken these <I>things</I> to you as I stay beside you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>But that Encourager (the Spirit, the Sacred <I>Spirit</I>, that the Father will send in My name) will teach you all <I>things</I> and will quietly remind you of all that I said to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>I am leaving peace with you. My peace I am giving to you (unlike how the world gives, I am giving to you). Your heart must not be uneasy, neither must it be cowardly.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>You heard that I said to you, 'I am making <I>My</I> way back and coming to you.' If you were loving Me, you would be happy that I said, 'I am traveling to the Father,' because My Father is greater than Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>And now I have stated <I>it</I> to you before <I>it is</I> to happen so that when it happens you might trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>I no longer will speak much with you. You see, the head of this world is coming, and he has nothing in Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>But <I>it will happen</I> so that the world might know that I love the Father, and just as the Father demanded Me, so I am doing. Get up. We should lead from here."</P>
<TITLE>John 15</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 15:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"I am the Vine, the True <I>Vine</I>, and My Father is the Farmer.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Every vine branch in Me not carrying fruit, He takes it off. And every <I>vine branch</I> carrying fruit, He prunes it so that it may carry more fruit.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>You are already clean because of the message that I have spoken to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Stay in Me and I in you. Just as the vine branch isn't able to be carrying fruit out from itself if it doesn't stay in the vine, so neither <I>can</I> you if you don't stay in Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>I am the Vine. You <I>are</I> the vine branches. The <I>person</I> staying in Me and I in him, this <I>person</I> carries much fruit because separate from Me you are not able to be doing anything.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>If anyone didn't stay in Me, he was thrown outside as the vine branch, he was shriveled up, they gather them together, they throw <I>them</I> into a fire, and he is burned.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>If you stay in Me and My statements stay in you, whatever you want you will ask for <I>it</I>, and it will happen to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>In this My Father was elevated to a place of magnificence, so that you may carry much fruit and you will become students to Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Just as the Father loved Me, I also loved you. Stay in the love, My <I>love</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>If you keep My demands, you will stay in My love, just as I have kept the demands of My Father, and I stay in His love.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I have spoken these <I>things</I> to you so that the happiness, My <I>happiness</I>, might stay in you and your happiness might be filled up.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>This is the demand, My <I>demand</I>, that you should love each other, just as I loved you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>No one has a greater love than this, that someone would put his soul <I>out there</I> on behalf of his friends.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You are My friends if you do as many <I>things</I> as I demand you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>I no longer call you slaves because the slave does not realize what his master is doing, but I have stated <I>that</I> you <I>are</I> friends because everything that I heard from the side of My Father I made known to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>You did not select Me, but I selected you and placed you so that you may make <I>your</I> way back, carry fruit, and your fruit stay, so that whatever you ask the Father for in My name, He might give you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>These <I>things</I> I demand you so that you may love each other.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>If the world hates you, you know that it has hated Me first <I>over</I> you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>If you were from the world, the world would be fond of <I>its</I> own. Because you are not from the world, but I selected you from the world, because of this the world hates you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Remember the message that I said to you, 'A slave is not greater than his master.' If they pursued Me, they also will pursue you. If they kept My message, they also will keep yours.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>But they will do all these <I>things</I> to you because of My name, because they do not know the <I>One</I> who sent Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>If I did not come and speak to them, they were not having sin, but now they do not have a sham about their sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>The <I>person</I> hating Me also hates My Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>If I didn't do the actions among them that no one else has done, they were not having sin. Now, they have both seen and hated both Me and My Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>But <I>it happened</I> so that the message (the <I>one</I> that has been written in their law <I>in Psalm 35:19 and 69:4</I>) might be accomplished, 'They hated Me for nothing.'</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>When that Encourager comes whom I will send to you from the side of the Father (the Spirit of the Truth that travels out from the side of the Father), He will tell what He witnesses about Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>And you are telling what you witnessed because from <I>the</I> beginning you are with Me."</P>

<P><A NAME="John 16:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>And when that <I>Encourager</I> comes, He will reprimand the world concerning sin, concerning <I>the</I> right way, and concerning judgment</P>

You see, He won't speak out from Himself, but however many <I>things</I> that He might hear He will speak, and He will announce to you the <I>things</I> coming.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>That <I>Encourager</I> will elevate Me to a place of magnificence because He will receive from My <I>Person</I> and announce <I>it</I> to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>All <I>things</I>, as many as the Father has, are Mine. Because of this, I said that He will receive from My <I>Person</I> and announce <I>it</I> to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>A little <I>while</I> and you do not see Me, and again, a little <I>while</I> and you will look at Me because I am making <I>My</I> way back to the Father."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So <I>some</I> from among His students said to each other, "What is this that He is saying to us, 'A little <I>while</I> and you do not see Me, and again a little <I>while</I> and you will look at Me,' and 'Because I am making <I>My</I> way back to the Father'?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>So they were saying, "What is this that He is saying, the 'little <I>while</I>'? We don't know what He is speaking."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So Jesus knew that they were wanting to be asking Him. And He said to them, "Are you looking with each other for <I>what I meant</I> about this that I said, 'A little <I>while</I> and you don't see Me, and again, a little <I>while</I> and you will look at Me'?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you that you will cry and wail. The world will be happy. You will be sad, but your sadness will become for happiness.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>When the woman is delivering, she has sadness because her hour came, but when the young child is born, she does not remember the hard times anymore, because of the happiness, that a person was born into the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>So you also now certainly have sadness, but I will see you again, your heart will be happy, and your happiness no one takes away from you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>And in that day, you won't ask Me anything. Amen, amen, I tell you, that however many <I>things</I> that you ask the Father for in My name, He will give to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Until now you did not ask for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive so that your happiness may be <I>happiness</I> that has been filled up.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>I have spoken these <I>things</I> to you in analogies. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in analogies, but I will announce to you with a clear public statement about the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>In that day, you will ask for <I>things</I> in My name, and I am not telling you that I will ask the Father about you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>You see, the Father Himself is fond of you because you have been fond of Me and have trusted that I came out from the side of God.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 16:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>His students say to Him, "Look, now you are speaking with a clear public statement and not telling any analogy.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>Now we know that You know everything and have no need that anyone should ask You <I>questions</I>. We trust in this, that You came out from God."</P>

<P><A NAME="John 16:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>Look, an hour is coming and has now come that you will be scattered each to <I>your</I> own <I>places</I> and will leave Me alone. And I am not alone because the Father is with Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>I have spoken these <I>things</I> to you so that you may have peace in Me. In the world, you will have hard times, but be courageous, I have conquered the world."</P>
<TITLE>John 17</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 17:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Jesus spoke these <I>things</I> and raised His eyes to the sky. And He said, "Father, the hour has come. Elevate Your Son to a place of magnificence so that the Son might also elevate You to a place of magnificence,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>just as You gave Him authority over every physical body so that for everything that You have given Him, He might give them life that spans <I>all</I> time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>This is the life that spans <I>all</I> time: that they may know You (the only true God) and whom You sent out <I>on a mission</I> (Jesus, <I>the</I> Anointed King).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>I elevated You to a place of magnificence on the earth. I completed the work that You have given Me that I might do.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And now, You, Father, elevate Me to a place of magnificence beside Yourself with the magnificence that I was having beside You before the <I>time</I> for the world to exist.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>I showed Your name to the people whom You have given to Me from the world. They were Yours, You have given them to Me, and they have kept Your message.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Now they have known that all <I>things</I>, as many as You have given to Me, they are from the side of You</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>because the statements that You have given to Me I have given to them and they received <I>them</I>, they truly knew that I came out from the side of You, and they trusted that You sent Me out <I>on a mission</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>I ask concerning them. I don't ask concerning the world, but concerning whom You have given Me because they are with You.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>And all My <I>things</I> are Yours, Your <I>things</I> <I>are</I> Mine, and I have been elevated to a place of magnificence in them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>And I am no longer in the world, these are in the world, and I am coming to You, Sacred Father. Keep them in Your name (whom You have given to Me) so that they may be one, just as We <I>are</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>When I was with them in the world, I was keeping them (whom You have given to Me) in Your name. I guarded <I>them</I>, and no one from among them was ruined except the son of the ruin, so that the <I>Old Testament</I> writing might be accomplished.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Now I am coming to You, and I am speaking these <I>things</I> in the world so that they may have the happiness, My <I>happiness</I>, that has been filled up in them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>I have given them Your message, and the world hated them because they are not from the world, just as I am not from the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>I don't ask that You might take them from the world, but that You might keep them from the evil <I>one</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>They are not from the world, just as I am not from the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Make them sacred in Your truth. The message, Your <I>message</I>, is truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Just as You sent Me out <I>on a mission</I> into the world, I also sent them out <I>on a mission</I> into the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>And on their behalf I make Myself sacred so that they themselves may also be <I>people</I> who have been made sacred in truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>I am not only asking concerning these <I>people</I>, but also concerning the <I>people</I> who will trust in Me through their message,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>so that all may be one, just as You, Father, <I>are</I> in Me and I in You, so that they also may be one in Us, so that the world may trust that You sent Me out <I>on a mission</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>And I have given them the magnificence that You have given Me so that they may be one, just as We are one.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>I in them and You in Me, so that they may be <I>people</I> who have been completed into one and so that the world may know that You sent Me out <I>on a mission</I> and You loved them, just as You loved Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Father, I want whom You have given Me so that where I am those <I>people</I> also may be with Me, so that they may see the magnificence, My <I>magnificence</I>, that You gave to Me because You loved Me before <I>the</I> founding of <I>the</I> world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Father, who does what is right, even the world didn't know You. I knew You, and these <I>people</I> knew that You sent Me out <I>on a mission</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>And I made Your name known to them, and I will make <I>it</I> known so that the love that You loved Me with may be in them and I in them.</P>
<TITLE>John 18</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 18:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After Jesus said these <I>things</I>, He went out together with His students to <I>the</I> other side of the stormwater basin of the Kidron where there was a garden into which He and His students went.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Judas (the <I>one</I> turning Him in) also knew the place because Jesus gathered there many times with His students.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>So after Judas takes the regiment and underlings from the head priests and Separatists, he comes there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>So Jesus, who knew all the <I>things</I> coming on Him, when He went out, said to them, "Who are you looking for?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>They answered Him, "Jesus, the Nazarene." Jesus says to them, "I am <I>Him</I>." Judas (the <I>one</I> turning Him in) had also stood with them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>So as He said to them, "I am <I>Him</I>," they went off into the <I>things left</I> behind and fell on the ground.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>So again He asked them, "Who are you looking for?" The <I>people</I> said, "Jesus, the Nazarene."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Jesus answered, "I told you that I am <I>Him</I>. So if you are looking for Me, leave these <I>people</I> to be making <I>their</I> way back <I>home</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN><I>He said this</I> so that the message that He said might be accomplished, 'I ruined no one from them whom You have given Me.'</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>So Simon Peter, having a dagger, pulled it, struck the slave of the head priest, and chopped off his ear lobe, the right <I>one</I>. <I>The</I> name <I>belonging</I> to the slave was Malchus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>So Jesus said to Peter, "Put your dagger into the sheath. The cup that the Father has given Me, should I not in any way drink it?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>So the regiment, the commanding officer, and the underlings of the Jewish <I>leaders</I> apprehended Jesus and tied Him up.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And they led Him off to Annas first. You see, he was <I>the</I> father-in-law of Caiaphas who was that year's head priest.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Caiaphas was the <I>one</I> who strongly advised to the Jewish <I>people</I> that it is advantageous for one person to be ruined on behalf of the ethnic group.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Simon Peter and another student were following Jesus. That student was known to the head priest, and he went into the courtyard of the head priest together with Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Peter had stood outside toward the door. So the student (the other <I>one</I> who was known by the head priest) went out, talked to the doorkeeper, and led Peter in.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So the servant girl (the doorkeeper) says to Peter, "You aren't also from the students of this Person, are you?" That <I>Peter</I> says, "I am not."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The slaves and the underlings had been standing <I>there</I>, who had made a bed of hot coals because it was cold, and they were warming <I>themselves</I>. Peter was with them, having stood <I>there</I> and warming himself.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So the head priest asked Jesus about His students and about His teaching.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Jesus answered him, "I spoke with a clear public statement to the world. I always taught in the synagogue and on the temple grounds where the Jewish <I>people</I> always come together, and in a hidden way I spoke nothing.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Why are you asking Me? Ask the <I>people</I> who have heard what I spoke to them. Look, these <I>people</I> know what I said."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>When He said these <I>things</I>, one of the underlings who had stood nearby gave Jesus a slap, after saying, "Are you answering the head priest like this?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Jesus answered him, "If I spoke in a bad way, tell what you witnessed about the bad <I>thing</I>. If <I>I spoke</I> nicely, why do you beat Me?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>So Annas sent Him out, who had been tied up, to Caiaphas, the head priest.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Simon Peter had been standing and warming himself. So they said to him, "You aren't also from His students, are you?" That <I>Peter</I> denied and said, "I am not."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>One from among the slaves of the head priest (who is a relative of <I>the</I> <I>man</I> whose ear lobe Peter chopped off) says, "Didn't I see you in the garden with Him?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>So again Peter denied, and right away a rooster crowed.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>So they lead Jesus out from Caiaphas into the Roman palace. It was morning, and they didn't go into the Roman palace so that they might not be desecrated, but so that they might eat the Passover.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>So Pilate came out to them and said, "What criminal complaint are you bringing against this person?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>They answered and said to him, "If this <I>man</I> wasn't a <I>person</I> who does bad things, we wouldn't have turned Him over to you."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>So Pilate said to them, "You must take Him and judge Him according to your law." So the Jewish <I>leaders</I> said to him, "It is not allowed for us to kill anyone."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>(<I>This happened</I> so that the message of Jesus might be accomplished that He said indicating what kind of death He was going to be dying.)</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>So Pilate went into the Roman palace again, hollered for Jesus, and said to Him, "Are You the king of the Jewish <I>people</I>?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>Jesus answered him, "Are you saying this out from yourself, or did others tell you about Me?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>Pilate answered, "I'm not Jewish, am I? The nation, Your <I>nation</I>, and the head priests turned You over to me. What did You do?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>Jesus answered, "The monarchy, My <I>monarchy</I>, isn't from this world. If the monarchy, My <I>monarchy</I>, was from this world, the underlings, My <I>underlings</I>, would be struggling so that I wouldn't be turned over to the Jewish <I>people</I>. But now, the monarchy, My <I>monarchy</I>, isn't from here."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>So Pilate said to Him, "So aren't You a king?" Jesus answered, "You are saying that I am a king. I have been born for this, and for this I have come into the world, so that I might tell what I witnessed of the truth. Everyone who is from the truth hears My voice."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>Pilate says to Him, "What is truth?" And after saying this, again he went out to the Jewish <I>leaders</I> and says to them, "I don't find even one accusation in Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>But it is a policy with you that I should dismiss one <I>person</I> to you during the Passover. So do you intend <I>that</I> I should dismiss the King of the Jewish <I>people</I> to you?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>So all <I>of them</I> made a yell again, saying, "Not this <I>Man</I>, but Barabbas." Barabbas was a bandit.</P>
<TITLE>John 19</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 19:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So at that time Pilate took Jesus and whipped <I>Him</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And the soldiers who wove an award wreath from thorns placed <I>it</I> on His head and put a purple robe around Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And they were saying, "Happy to meet You, the King of the Jewish <I>people</I>," and they were giving Him slaps.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>So Pilate came outside again and says to them, "Look, I lead Him outside to you so that you might know that in Him I don't find even one accusation."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>So Jesus came outside wearing the thorny award wreath and the purple robe. And he says to them, "Look, the Person."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>So when the head priests and the underlings saw Him, they made a yell, saying, "Nail <I>Him</I> to a cross. Nail <I>Him</I> to a cross." Pilate says to them, "You must take Him and nail <I>Him</I> to a cross. You see, I don't find in Him an accusation."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The Jewish <I>people</I> responded to him, "We have a law, and according to our law He ought to die because He made Himself a son of God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>So when Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>And he went into the Roman palace again. And he says to Jesus, "Where are You from?" But Jesus did not give him a response.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>So Pilate says to Him, "Are You not speaking to me? Don't You realize that I have authority to nail You to a cross and I have authority to dismiss You?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Jesus answered, "You don't have even one <I>bit</I> of authority against Me unless it has been given to you from above. Because of this, the <I>one</I> who turned Me over to you has a bigger sin."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>From this <I>time on</I>, Pilate was looking to dismiss Him, but the Jewish <I>people</I> were yelling, saying, "If you dismiss this <I>Man</I>, you are not a friend of Caesar. Everyone making himself a king is expressing opposition to Caesar."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>So when Pilate heard this saying, he led Jesus outside and was seated on the judicial bench in a place called "Paved with Stone" ("Gabbatha" in Hebrew).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>It was a preparation <I>day</I> of the Passover, but an hour as if <I>it were</I> <I>the</I> sixth <I>(noon)</I>. And he says to the Jewish <I>people</I>, "Look, your King."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>But the <I>people</I> made a yell, "Take <I>Him</I> away. Take <I>Him</I> away. Nail Him to a cross." Pilate said to them, "Will I nail your King to a cross?" The head priests answered, "We do not have a king except Caesar."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>So at that time, he turned Him over to them so that He might be nailed to a cross. They took Jesus along and led <I>Him</I> away.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>And hauling His cross, He went out to the <I>place</I> called Place of a Skull, that in Hebrew is called Golgotha,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>where they nailed Him to a cross and two others with Him, on this side and on this side, but Jesus in <I>the</I> middle.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Pilate also wrote a placard and placed it on the cross. It had been written, "Jesus, the Nazarene, the King of the Jewish <I>people</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>So this placard many of the Jewish <I>people</I> read because the place where Jesus was nailed to a cross was near the city and it had been written in Hebrew, in Latin, in Greek.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>So the head priests of the Jewish <I>people</I> were saying to Pilate, "Don't write, 'The King of the Jewish <I>people</I>,' but 'That <I>Man</I> said I am a king of the Jewish <I>people</I>'."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>So the soldiers, when they nailed Jesus to a cross, took His clothes and made four parts, a part for each soldier, and the long undershirt. But the long seamless undershirt was woven from the top through all of <I>it</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>So they said to each other, "We should not tear it up, but we should throw dice concerning it, whose it will be." <I>This happened</I> so that the <I>Old Testament</I> writing <I>in Psalm 22:18</I> might be accomplished that says, "They divided up my clothes for themselves and threw dice on my clothing." So the soldiers certainly did these <I>things</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>His mother, the sister of His mother, Mary (the <I>wife</I> of Clopas), and Mary (the Magdalene) had stood beside the cross of Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>So when Jesus saw <I>His</I> mother and the student whom He <I>kept</I> loving standing nearby, He says to His mother, "Ma'am, look, your son."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>After that He says to the student, "Look, your mother." And from that hour, the student took her to <I>his</I> own <I>places</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>After this, Jesus realizing that He had already finished everything, so that the <I>Old Testament</I> writing <I>in Psalm 69:21</I> might be completed, He says, "I am thirsty."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>So a container was lying <I>there</I> full of sour wine. After they filled a sponge with sour wine and put <I>it</I> around a hyssop <I>stick</I>, they offered <I>it</I> to His mouth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>So when Jesus took the sour wine, He said, "It has been finished." And when He put <I>His</I> head down, He gave up the spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>So the Jewish <I>people</I>, since it was a preparation <I>day</I>, so that the bodies wouldn't stay on the cross during the Sabbath (you see, the day of that Sabbath was big), they asked Pilate that their legs would be broken and they would be taken away</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>So the soldiers went and certainly broke the legs of the first <I>man</I> and of the other <I>man</I>, the <I>man</I> who was nailed to a cross together with Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>But when they came up to Jesus, as they saw that He had already died, they didn't break His legs.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>But one of the soldiers stabbed His side with a spear, and right away blood and water came out.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>And the <I>person</I> who has seen <I>it</I> has told what he witnessed, and his witness account is true. And that <I>person</I> realizes that he is saying valid <I>things</I>, so that you might trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>You see, these <I>things</I> happened so that the <I>Old Testament</I> writing <I>in Exodus 12:46, Numbers 9:12, and Psalm 34:20</I> might be accomplished. "A bone of His will not be crushed."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>And again a different <I>Old Testament</I> writing says <I>in Zechariah 12:10</I>, "They will look to whom they impaled."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>After these <I>things</I>, Joseph (the <I>one</I> out of Arimathaea, who was a student of Jesus, but had been hid because of <I>his</I> fear of the Jewish <I>people</I>) asked Pilate that he might take the body of Jesus, and Pilate gave permission. So he went and took the body of Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>Nicodemus (the <I>one</I> who came to Jesus at night the first <I>time</I>) also came, bringing a mixture of myrrh <I>(expensive perfume)</I> and aloe, as if <I>it were</I> seventy-five pounds.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>So they took the body of Jesus and tied it up in linen strips with the fragrant resins, just as <I>the</I> custom is for the Jewish <I>people</I> to be preparing <I>a corpse</I> for burial.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>In the place where He was nailed to a cross, there was a garden, and in the garden a new burial vault in which no one was placed yet.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>So they put Jesus there because of the preparation <I>day</I> of the Jewish <I>people</I>, because the burial vault was near.</P>
<TITLE>John 20</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 20:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>On the <I>Day</I> 1 after the Sabbaths, Mary (the Magdalene) comes to the burial vault in <I>the</I> morning, it still being dark, and sees the stone that has been taken away from the burial vault.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>So she runs and comes to Simon Peter and to the other student whom Jesus <I>kept</I> being fond of. And she says to them, "They took the Master from the burial vault, and we don't know where they put Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>So Peter and the other student went out and were going to the burial vault.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>The two were running at the same time. And the other student ran ahead faster than Peter and came first to the burial vault.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And when he stooped and peered in, he sees the linen strips lying there; however, he did not go in.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>So Simon Peter comes following him. And he went into the burial vault and sees the linen strips lying there</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>and the towel that was on His head, not lying with the linen strips, but separate from <I>them</I>, having been wound up into one place.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>So at that time, the other student, the <I>one</I> who came first, also went into the burial vault, looked, and trusted.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>You see, they didn't yet realize the <I>Old Testament</I> writing that <I>says</I> it is necessary for Him to come back to life from <I>the</I> dead.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>So the students went off again to their <I>own</I> <I>places</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>But Mary had stood facing the burial vault crying outside. So as she was crying, she stooped and peered into the burial vault,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>and she sees two angels in white seated, one near the head and one near the feet, where the body of Jesus was lying.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And those <I>angels</I> say to her, "Ma'am, why are you crying?" She says to them, "Because they took my Master away and I don't know where they put Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>And after she said these <I>things</I>, she turned to the <I>things left</I> behind, sees Jesus who has stood <I>there</I>, and didn't realize that it is Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Jesus says to her, "Ma'am, why are you crying? Who are you looking for?" That <I>Mary</I> thinking that He is the gardener says to Him, "Master, if you hauled Him off, tell me where you put Him, and I will take Him away."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Jesus says to her, "Mary." When that <I>Mary</I> turned, she says to Him, "Rabboni" <I>(Great Rabbi)</I>, that is said <I>in place of</I> Teacher.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Jesus says to her, "Don't touch Me. You see, I have not yet stepped up to My Father. Travel <I>off</I> to My brothers, and tell them I am stepping up to My Father, your Father, My God, and your God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Mary (the Magdalene) comes, reporting to the students that she had seen the Master and He said these <I>things</I> to her.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So being evening on that day, the <I>Day</I> 1 after the Sabbaths, and the doors having been closed where the students were gathered together because of the fear of the Jewish <I>people</I>, Jesus went, stood in the middle, and says to them, "Peace to you."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>And when He said this, He showed them <I>His</I> hands and His side. So the students were happy when they saw the Master.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>So Jesus said to them again, "Peace to you. Just as the Father has sent Me out <I>on a mission</I>, I am also sending you."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>And when He said this, He puffed on <I>them</I> and says to them, "Receive <I>the</I> Sacred Spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven to them. If you hold on to <I>the sins</I> of any, they have been held on to."</P>

<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I am making the good news known to you, brothers, the <I>good news</I> that was shared by me, that it is not according to a person;</P>

<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You see, you heard of my behavior in the past in Judaism, that even more <I>than others</I> I was pursuing the assembly of God and damaging it,</P>

<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>to uncover His Son in me so that I may share the good news of Him among the non-Jews, I didn't consult right away with a physical body and blood.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Neither did I go up into Jerusalem to the missionaries before me. But I went off into Arabia and returned again into Damascus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Following that, after three years, I went up into Jerusalem to visit Peter. And I stayed over for fifteen days with him.</P>

<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Following that through fourteen years, I walked up to Jerusalem again with Barnabas when we also took Titus along together with <I>us</I>.</P>

And I laid out to them the good news that I speak about publicly among the non-Jews, but privately to the <I>people</I> who seem <I>to be something</I>, that somehow I may not run or ran for a meaningless <I>cause</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>(but neither was Titus, the Greek who was together with me, compelled to be circumcised)</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>because of the undetected counterfeit brothers, some who quietly came in to spy out <I>and plot against</I> our freedom that we have in <I>the</I> Anointed King Jesus so that they might make us complete slaves,</P>

<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>To be something from the <I>people</I> seeming <I>to be something</I>, whatever kind of <I>people</I> they were in the past, is not more substantial to me. <P><A NAME="Galatians 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>But just the opposite, when they saw that I had been trusted with the good news of the uncircumcision, just as Peter <I>had been trusted with the good news</I> of the circumcision</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>(you see, the <I>One</I> who was active with Peter for <I>his</I> mission to the circumcision, was also active with me for the non-Jews),</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>and after knowing the generosity, the <I>generosity</I> that was given to me, James, Cephas <I>(Aramaic for Peter)</I>, and John (the <I>ones</I> seeming to be pillars) gave right <I>hands</I> of a sharing relationship to me and Barnabas so that we <I>are</I> for the non-Jews, but they for the circumcision;</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>only of the poor: that we should remember <I>them</I>; this same <I>thing</I> that I also made every effort to do.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>But when Peter came to Antioch, I stood in opposition to him right in front of <I>his</I> face because it was <I>something</I> that had been known against <I>him</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>You see, before the <I>time</I> for certain <I>people</I> to come out from James, he was eating together with the non-Jews. <P><A NAME="Galatians 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>But when I saw that they are not straight-footed toward the truth of the good news, I said to Peter in front of everyone, "If you, being Jewish, are living non-Jewishly and not Jewishly, why do you compel the non-Jews to become Jews?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>We <I>are</I> Jewish by nature and not sinful <I>people</I> from <I>the</I> non-Jews,</P>

<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>You see, if I again build these <I>things</I> that I tore down, I myself stand together with a violator.</P>

<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Together with <I>the</I> Anointed King I have been nailed to a cross. I no longer live, but <I>the</I> Anointed King lives in me.
