<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>I don't invalidate the generosity of God. You see, if <I>the</I> right way <I>is</I> through <I>the</I> law, clearly <I>the</I> Anointed King died for nothing.</P>
<TITLE>Galatians 3</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>O unobservant Galatians, who tricked you to not believe the truth (to whom, right in front of <I>your</I> eyes, Jesus, <I>the</I> Anointed King, was openly written about among you, that He had been nailed to a cross)?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>I only want to learn this out of you, did you receive the Spirit from actions of <I>the</I> law or from what was heard of trust?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>This is how you are unobservant. After beginning in on <I>it</I> with <I>the</I> Spirit, are you now finishing up with <I>the</I> physical body?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Did you suffer so many <I>things</I> for no reason, if <I>it</I> definitely even <I>is</I> for no reason?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>So the <I>One</I> further supplying the Spirit to you and active with abilities among you, <I>is He</I> from actions of <I>the</I> law or from what is heard of trust?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Just as, "Abraham trusted God, and it was considered to him for <I>the</I> right way" <I>(Genesis 15:6)</I>,</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>you clearly know that the <I>people</I> from trust, these are sons of Abraham.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When the <I>Old Testament</I> writing saw beforehand that God makes the non-Jews right from trust, it shared good news with Abraham beforehand, "All the non-Jews will be conferred with blessings in you" <I>(Genesis 22:18)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>In such a way, the <I>people</I> from trust are conferred with blessings together with trusting Abraham.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You see, as many as are from actions of <I>the</I> law are under a curse; for it has been written <I>in Deuteronomy 27:26</I>, "Everyone <I>is</I> cursed who does not stay in all the <I>things</I> that have been written in the scroll of the law, of the 'to do them' <I>kind</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>That no one is made right in <I>the</I> law beside God, <I>it is</I> obvious, because, "The <I>person</I> who does what is right will live from trust" <I>(Habakkuk 2:4)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>The law is not from trust, but "the person who does these <I>things</I> will live in them."</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN><I>The</I> Anointed King purchased us from the curse of the law after becoming a curse on our behalf. You see, it has been written <I>in Deuteronomy 21:23</I>, "Everyone who hangs on a wooden cross is cursed,"</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>so that Abraham's conferring of blessing might become for the non-Jews in <I>the</I> Anointed King Jesus, so that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through the trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Brothers, in the same manner, a person's deal (I am talking regarding a person) that has been made official, no one invalidates <I>it</I> or adds to <I>it</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>To Abraham the promises were stated and to his seed. He does not say, "and to the seeds," as <I>if</I> based on many, but as <I>if</I> based on one, "and to your seed," who is <I>the</I> Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>I am saying this: a deal (that has been made official beforehand by God for <I>the</I> Anointed King), the law (that has happened after four hundred and thirty years) does not nullify for the "to make the promise useless" <I>part</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>You see, if the inheritance is from <I>the</I> law, <I>it is</I> no longer from a promise. But to Abraham through a promise, God, in an act of generosity, has given <I>the inheritance</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So why <I>does</I> the law <I>exist</I>? Thanks to the violations. It was added till <I>a time</I> that the seed would come, to whom <I>(Abraham),</I> it has been promised after being specifically arranged through angels in <I>the</I> hand of a middleman.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>The middleman is not <I>a middleman</I> of one. But God is one.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>So <I>is</I> the law against the promises of God? It could not happen. You see, if the law was given that is able to give life, the right way really would have been from <I>the</I> law.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>But the <I>Old Testament</I> writing closed everything up under sin, so that the promise from trust of Jesus, <I>the</I> Anointed King, might be given to the <I>people</I> trusting.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Before the <I>time</I> for the trust to come, we were being watched over by <I>the</I> law, having been closed up into the trust that is going to be uncovered.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>In such a way, the law has become our babysitter for <I>the</I> Anointed King so that from trust we might be made right.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>But when the trust comes, we are no longer under a babysitter.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>You see, you are all sons of God through the trust in <I>the</I> Anointed King Jesus;</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>for as many of you as were submerged into <I>the</I> Anointed King put on <I>the</I> Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>There is not Jewish, nor Greek. There is not slave, nor free. There is not male and female. You see, you all are one in <I>the</I> Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>If you <I>are</I> <I>the</I> Anointed King's, clearly you are Abraham's seed and<I> </I>inheritors aligned with a promise.</P>
<TITLE>Galatians 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>I say, over as much time as the inheritor is an infant, he is nothing more substantial than a slave though he is master of <I>them</I> all.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>But he is under administrators and managers till the predetermined time of the father.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>This is how we also, when we were infants, were <I>people</I> who had been enslaved under the conventional practices of the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>But when the fullness of the time came, God sent off His Son, who became from a woman, who became under <I>the</I> law,</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>so that He might purchase the <I>people</I> under <I>the</I> law from <I>the conventional practices</I> so that we might fully receive the adoption.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Because you are sons, God sent off the Spirit of His Son into your hearts, yelling, "Daddy, the Father!"</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>In such a way, you are no longer a slave, but a son. If <I>you are</I> a son, <I>you are</I> also an inheritor of God through <I>the</I> Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>But at that time, when you certainly didn't know God, you were slaves to the <I>things</I> that by nature are not gods.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Now, after knowing God, rather, being known by God, how are you turning back again to the weak and poor conventional practices that you want to be slaves to all over again?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You closely watch days, months, certain times, and years.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I am afraid <I>when it comes to</I> you that somehow I have labored for you for no reason.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Become as me because I also <I>am</I> as you, brothers. I plead with you. You didn't harm me in any way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You realize that because of a weakness of <I>my</I> physical body, I shared good news with you the prior <I>time</I>,</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>and you didn't treat my trouble in my physical body as a bad thing, nor despise <I>it</I>, but as an angel of God, you accepted me as <I>the</I> Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>So what was your blessedness? You see, I am a witness to you that, if possible, after plucking out your eyes, you would have given <I>them</I> to me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>In such a way, have I become your enemy, being true to you?</P>
